title: The Best Summerween Merch to Shop, From Spooky Squishmallows to Limited-Edition Disney Collectibles
summary: As Halloween fans celebrate earlier than ever, retailers are rolling out spooky decor, collectibles and apparel months before October arrives.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Halloween may still be months away but that hasn’t stopped Summerween (summer Halloween, get it?) from becoming one of the season’s biggest trends. What began as a niche celebration among Halloween enthusiasts has grown into a full-fledged cultural moment, with retailers, social media and fans embracing spooky season long before October arrives.

The trend is even making its way into music. “Dracula” by Tame Impala and JENNIE climbed from No. 25 to No. 8 on the Billboard Hot 100 , as interest continues to gain momentum. Add in Halloween-loving celebrities like Heidi Klum, Vanessa Hudgens and Lady Gaga, who have made the holiday part of their signature style over the years, and it’s easy to see why Summerween has found a devoted following.

With Halloween culture expanding beyond its traditional October timeline, the demand for spooky-season essentials is arriving earlier than ever. From collectible pieces inspired by fan-favorite characters to decor and apparel that celebrate the season, these are the best Summerween finds to shop right now.

NEW RELEASE

The Haunted Mansion

Glow-in-the-Dark Spirit Jersey for Adults

$84.99

Buy Now at Disney Store

Made from 100% cotton and features a glow-in-the-dark logo on the back.

The Disney Store’s latest Haunted Mansion collection arrives just in time for Summerween, and this glow-in-the-dark jersey is one of the standout pieces. Crafted from a heavyweight knit fabric, the purple pullover features a subtle Haunted Mansion puffy ink graphic and three spooky bats on the front, while the back showcases a larger glow-in-the-dark logo that brings the iconic attraction to life after dark.

AFFORDABLE & EASY

Coogam

60PCS Halloween Bats Decoration

$9.99

Buy Now On Amazon

Easy to remove and reuse PVC bat stickers.

For an easy Summerween decorating upgrade, these 3D PVC bats are hard to beat. The viral wall decals have become a social media favorite thanks to their dramatic effect and budget-friendly $9.99 price tag. Each set includes 60 reusable bats in a mix of sizes, making it easy to create a spooky display in minutes. Better yet, they’re easy to remove and store, so you can bring them back out for both Summerween celebrations and Halloween festivities later in the year.

SKULL DECOR

Pumpkin Carving

Wallflowers Fragrance Refill

$3.95 $8.95 56% off

Buy Now at bath & Body Works

0.8 fl oz / 24 ml

Even after Summerween comes to an end, this Wallflowers fragrance refill is a spooky-season staple worth keeping around. Its skull-shaped design makes it an easy addition to Halloween decor, while the Pumpkin Carving scent delivers cozy fall notes of freshly carved pumpkin, spiced pumpkin seeds and smooth brown sugar. Plus, it’s currently on sale for under $4, with each refill lasting up to 30 days for a subtle, room-filling fragrance boost.

VIRAL PICK

Ghost Host Loungefly Mini Backpack

$90

Designed after The Haunted Mansion ‘s Ghost Host butler suit.

Inspired by The Haunted Mansion ’s Ghost Host butler uniform, this Loungefly mini-backpack is a Summerween-ready accessory that Disney fans can carry beyond spooky season. It features a die-cut bow tie, striped vest design, lapel details, buttons on the main compartment and a “Ghost Host From Regions Beyond” badge appliqué for an authentic nod to the movie.

SPOOKY FASHION

Addams Family

Wednesday Thing Claw Hair Clip

$6.99 $13.99 50% off

Buy Now At Hot Topic

Four-inch-long hair clip.

When it comes to wearing Halloween-inspired fashion year-round, the Addams Family has become a go-to source of spooky style inspiration. For a subtle hair accessory to celebrate the early spooky season, this Thing hair clip is inspired by Netflix’s Wednesday . Made from nickel-free alloy and measuring just four inches long, It’s a playful nod to the Addams Family that fans can wear beyond spooky season. Plus, it’s on sale for 50% off.

SELL OUT RISK

Glow-in-the-Dark Circus Luminary

Three-Wick Candle Holder

$275

A spooky accessory made to hold your three-wick candle.

Every year, Bath & Body Works releases collectible candle holders that become must-have pieces for Halloween fans, and this Summerween season is no exception. The brand’s latest circus-themed luminary doubles as daytime decor before transforming at night with a glow-in-the-dark display. While these decorative candle holders often come with a higher price tag, dedicated Halloween enthusiasts will want to grab this one quickly since they tend to sell out every year.

SQUISHABLE COLLECTIBLES

Hitchhiking Ghosts Squishmallows Plush Set

$49.99

A set of three squishmallows plush inspired by The Haunted Mansion hitchhiking ghosts.

Made for ages three and up, this Squishmallows plush set features Ezra Beane, Professor Phineas Plump and Gus from Disney’s Haunted Mansion . Crafted from soft, fuzzy fabrics that are perfect for squeezing, the trio also arrives in a Doom Buggy-inspired box, making it a must-have collectible for foolish mortals ready to celebrate Summerween.

3D MOVING PORTRAITS

BBTO Store

Moving Portrait Haunted Pictures 3D Set

$11.99

Set of six Halloween moving picture frames with changing faces.

For those looking to create their own Haunted Mansion -inspired experience at home, this set of six moving portraits brings the iconic attraction’s eerie aesthetic to any space. Each gothic-style portrait features a haunting image that transforms into a creepy face as you walk past, creating a 3D illusion. The largest portrait measures approximately 13.6 x 9.8 inches, while the smallest measures approximately 12.8 x 9.8 inches.

LIMITED EDITION COLLECTIBLE

Werecat Lady Limited Edition Doll

$149.99

Collector’s Werecat Lady 17-inch doll with a certificate of verification.

This limited-edition doll of the “Werecat Lady” from the portrait hallway in The Haunted Mansion is available in a limited quantity of just 5,150 worldwide. The fully poseable doll features the character’s hypnotic eyes, midnight-black dress and transformation into a fierce tigress. It arrives reclining on a rose brocade divan inside a window display box that can be mounted on the wall, and includes a certificate of verification.

FAN FAVORITE

Funko Sonic The Hedgehog

Pop! Tails As Mummy Vinyl Figure

Buy Now At Hot Topic $15.90 $15.90

Use HTDEAL for 20% off your order.

Measuring four inches tall, this Sonic the Hedgehog Pop! Tails as Mummy figure is a Funko collectible that doubles as year-round decor. Featuring Tails dressed as a mummy, it’s a subtle way to bring a Summerween-inspired detail to your space without going over the top. Add it to your Funko Pop! collection or gaming lineup for a spooky-season collectible you can display anytime.

What is Summerween? And How Did It Begin?

The term ‘Summerween’ originated in Disney’s Gravity Falls . In the show’s 2012 episode of the same name, Grunkle Stan jokes that the town loves Halloween so much it celebrates the holiday twice a year. More than a decade later, that fictional tradition has become a real-life celebration.

Retailers are also fully leaning into the trend. Spirit Halloween recently launched a Summerween collection featuring Terrifier -inspired merchandise that sold out quickly alongside themed pool floats and other spooky summer essentials. Disney, Bath & Body works and other major brands have begun releasing Halloween collections earlier than ever as demand for seasonal merchandise continues to grow.
